findings.title: Require every requested regression selector to execute
findings.body: The fresh-regression validator only verifies that each retained node belongs to any selector and that JUnit agrees with that retained collection. It accepts a correctly hashed, fresh multi-path run containing cases from only the first path. Independent synthetic Git reproduction returns no errors for the KL029 combined shadow unit/DB suite with zero DB shadow cases, and for combined migrations/transaction-interface regression with the second file omitted. This violates M3_CLOSURE_CONTRACT.md's full integrated-regression requirement that selectors cannot be omitted. Require every selector to have collected/executed cases, correct the positive fixture's split()[0] truncation, and add an omitted-selector negative that passes freshness/hash/JUnit preconditions before failing the coverage oracle. Retest and rereview the repaired revision.
